input.name: images
notes: Scale by r = min(height / h, width / w), resize to (int(w * r), int(h * r)) and paste onto a canvas filled with 114.
Paste position comes from the letterbox_pad metadata key: topleft puts the image in the top-left corner, center splits the padding on both sides. A missing key means topleft.

outputs.name: output
outputs.meaning: Rows 0 to 3 are x1, y1, x2, y2 in input-canvas pixels. Rows 4 onward are per-class scores, sigmoid already applied. anchors is the cell count over strides 8, 16 and 32, 8400 at 640 x 640.

postprocess: Keep every (anchor, class) pair whose score is above the confidence threshold (0.25 by default). One anchor can yield several classes.
Run NMS per class with IoU 0.45 and keep at most 300 detections.
Map boxes back to the original image: subtract the pad offset, divide by r, clip to the image.
Drop boxes whose width or height is 0 after clipping.

outputs.name: output
outputs.meaning: Rows are x1, y1, x2, y2, score, class in input-canvas pixels, zero-padded past the detection count. Confidence, IoU and max_det are baked in and recorded as nms_conf, nms_iou and max_det metadata.

outputs.name: raw
outputs.meaning: The same tensor as the default export's output, before suppression.

postprocess: Drop rows whose score is 0 or below your threshold.
Map boxes back to the original image: subtract the pad offset, divide by r, clip to the image.

input.name: images
notes: Scale by r = min(height / h, width / w), resize to (int(w * r), int(h * r)) and paste onto a canvas filled with 114.
Paste position comes from the letterbox_pad metadata key: topleft puts the image in the top-left corner, center splits the padding on both sides. A missing key means topleft.
This model has no nms=True export. The exporter raises NotImplementedError, so only the default export below exists.

outputs.name: output
outputs.meaning: Predictions of the one-to-one head only. Rows 0 to 3 are x1, y1, x2, y2 in input-canvas pixels. Rows 4 onward are per-class scores, sigmoid already applied. anchors is the cell count over strides 8, 16 and 32, 8400 at 640 x 640.

postprocess: Flatten the [anchors, nc] scores into one list of anchors x nc (anchor, class) pairs. Pair i belongs to anchor i / nc (integer division) and class i % nc.
Keep the 300 highest-scoring pairs (max_det), highest first. One anchor can yield several classes.
Of those, keep the pairs whose score is above the confidence threshold (0.25 by default).
Do not run NMS. The one-to-one head is trained to fire once per object, and LibreYOLO ignores the iou setting for this model.
Map boxes back to the original image: subtract the pad offset, divide by r, clip to the image.
Drop boxes whose width or height is 0 after clipping.
